```{r}
#| label: slides-setup
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(stringr)
  library(patchwork); library(scales); library(forcats); library(ggrepel); library(gt)
})
source("R/utils.R")
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE); set.seed(1234)

DER <- "data/derived"
RP <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "report.rds"))
SC <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "scenario.rds"))
MC <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "mci.rds"))
AR <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_ridership.rds"))
AF <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_frames.rds"))
AM <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "audit_markets.rds"))
dE <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "dest_existing.rds"))
hex <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "hex_markets.rds"))
land <- readRDS(file.path(DER, "land.rds"))

NT <- SC$new_tbl; OT <- SC$old_tbl; TT <- SC$totals; SN <- SC$sens_tbl; LT <- RP$ladder_tbl
lad <- function(key) LT[grepl(key, LT$model, fixed = TRUE), ]
ch  <- function(par, term) par$estimate[par$term == term]
stn <- function(name, col, t = OT) t[[col]][t$station_name == name]
chg <- function(x, d = 0) sprintf("%s%s%%", ifelse(x >= 0, "+", "−"), formatC(abs(100 * x), format = "f", digits = d))
num <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d) |> str_replace("^-", "−")
rnd <- function(x, to = 100) n_fmt(round(x / to) * to)
lnk <- function(a, b) MC$links$pct[MC$links$a_name == a & MC$links$b_name == b]
xf  <- function(s, col = "change") MC$xfer[[col]][MC$xfer$station_name == s]

# The deck's paper colour, so that a plot does not read as a white card on the slide.
PAPER <- "#f7f7f5"
theme_update(plot.background = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev.args = list(bg = PAPER))

paper_bits <- function() theme(
  plot.background   = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
  panel.background  = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA),
  legend.key        = element_rect(fill = PAPER, colour = NA))
theme_slide <- function(base = 15) theme_th(base) + paper_bits()
theme_slide_map <- function(base = 14) theme_map(base) + paper_bits()

XL <- c(2500, 47500); YL <- c(21500, 50500)
links_old <- MC$links |> filter(!line %in% c("JS", "JE", "JW", "CR"))
links_new <- MC$links |> filter(line %in% c("JS", "JE", "JW", "CR"))
net_layer <- function(col = "#a8a29e", lw = 0.35) geom_segment(data = links_old, aes(x = ax, y = ay, xend = bx, yend = by), colour = col, linewidth = lw)
new_layer <- function(lw = 0.8) geom_segment(data = links_new, aes(x = ax, y = ay, xend = bx, yend = by), colour = PAL$new, linewidth = lw)
map_base <- function(..., base = 14, xl = XL, yl = YL) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "#ecebe8", colour = "#d6d3d1", linewidth = 0.25) +
    list(...) +
    coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = FALSE, xlim = xl, ylim = yl) +
    theme_slide_map(base)
}
# The sea south-east of the island is empty, so the legends go there and the map keeps the width.
inside_legend <- function(x = .84, y = .13) theme(
  legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(x, y), legend.box = "vertical",
  legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.title.position = "top",
  legend.key.width = unit(.75, "cm"), legend.key.height = unit(.3, "cm"), legend.spacing.y = unit(.1, "cm"))
hi <- hex |> select(hex_id) |> inner_join(SC$hex_impact, by = c("hex_id" = "origin")) |> filter(residents > 0)
RES <- sum(SC$hex_impact$residents)
```

::: {.card-grid .cols-3 .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-quiet}

::: {.en}
*How well can a spatial interaction model reproduce ridership, including at stations it never saw, and what makes a station attractive?*
:::

*空间交互模型能在多大程度上复现客流（包括未见过的车站）？什么让车站具有吸引力？*
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">RQ2 · Predict</span><span class="zh">RQ2 · 预测</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
*What ridership can the Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line Phase 1 stations expect, and which risk being too quiet?*
:::
::: {.zh}
*裕廊区域线与跨岛线第一期车站可望有多少客流？哪些可能过于冷清？*
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">RQ3 · Impact</span><span class="zh">RQ3 · 影响</span>]{.lab}

*How would they change ridership and market areas at stations already open, and how far does the effect reach?*
:::
::: {.zh}
*它们将如何改变既有车站的客流与市场区？影响能延伸多远？*
:::
:::

:::

::: {.card-grid .cols-3 .t-xs}
::: {.card}
[<span class="en">Calibrate</span><span class="zh">校准</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Distance alone explains **nothing**. Mode, interchange status, retail and rail time to the CBD do. **Bus stops add nothing.**
:::
::: {.zh}
单靠距离**什么也解释不了**。起作用的是制式、换乘地位、零售与到 CBD 的轨道时间。**公交站数量没有贡献。**
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">Predict</span><span class="zh">预测</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Serangoon North** leads at about `r rnd(NT$E_closed[NT$station_name == "Serangoon North"], 1000)`. **Aviation Park, Jurong Pier, Tengah** are lowest, near 3,000.
:::
::: {.zh}
**Serangoon North** 居首，约 `r rnd(NT$E_closed[NT$station_name == "Serangoon North"], 1000)` 次。**Aviation Park、Jurong Pier、Tengah** 最低，约 3,000 次。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Impact</span><span class="zh">影响</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Pioneer `r chg(stn("Pioneer", "chg_closed"))`**, Lakeside `r chg(stn("Lakeside", "chg_closed"))`. Boon Lay's tap-ins fall, but it gains **`r rnd(xf("Boon Lay"), 1000)` transfers a day**.
:::
::: {.zh}
**Pioneer `r chg(stn("Pioneer", "chg_closed"))`**，Lakeside `r chg(stn("Lakeside", "chg_closed"))`。Boon Lay 进站量下降，却每日增加 **`r rnd(xf("Boon Lay"), 1000)` 次换乘**。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.takeaway}
[<span class="en">In one line</span><span class="zh">一句话</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
The new stations fill gaps in a dense network: they shorten access for many residents, draw much of their ridership from stations nearby, and turn one-line stations into busy interchanges.
:::
::: {.zh}
新站填补了密集网络中的空隙：它们缩短了许多居民的到达距离，客流大多来自附近车站，并使只有一条线路的车站变成繁忙的换乘站。
:::
:::

## <span class="en">Analytical approach</span><span class="zh">分析方法</span> {#approach}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">03 · A HUFF MODEL WITH TWO ENDS</span><span class="zh">03 · 两端的 Huff 模型</span>
:::

$$P_{ij} = \frac{A_j\, d_{ij}^{\,\lambda}}{\sum_{k:\, d_{ik}\le 5\,\text{km}} A_k\, d_{ik}^{\,\lambda}}, \qquad A_j = \exp(\mathbf{x}_j'\boldsymbol\beta), \qquad E_j = \sum_i M_i P_{ij}$$

::: {.card-grid .cols-4 .t-xxs}
::: {.card}
[<span class="en">1 · Split the trip</span><span class="zh">1 · 拆分出行</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Morning tap-ins and tap-outs divide each station's ridership into a **home end** (residents, dormitories) and an **activity end** (workplaces, points of interest), fitted separately.
:::
::: {.zh}
早高峰进出站量把每个车站的客流分为**居住端**（居民、宿舍）与**活动端**（工作场所、兴趣点），分别拟合。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">2 · Calibrate</span><span class="zh">2 · 校准</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Squared log error with exact gradients. Attraction variables, the exponent and market weights are estimated, with a **5 km choice set**.
:::
::: {.zh}
以平方对数误差为目标，使用精确梯度。估计吸引力变量、指数与市场权重，**选择集为 5 公里**。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">3 · Test against nulls</span><span class="zh">3 · 对照基准模型</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
A ladder from nearest station to the final model; **leave-one-line-out** on nine lines; a permutation null; a low-ridership AUC.
:::
::: {.zh}
从最近车站到最终模型的阶梯；九条线路的**逐线留出**；置换基准；低客流 AUC。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">4 · Forecast</span><span class="zh">4 · 预测</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Existing stations **pivot** on what they carry; new stations come from the model. 300 bootstrap draws, with noise from hold-out errors.
:::
::: {.zh}
既有车站以实际客流为**转折基准**；新站来自模型。300 次自助抽样，噪声来自留出误差。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.takeaway}
[<span class="en">Why not `huff.fit()`</span><span class="zh">为何不用 `huff.fit()`</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Exact calibration reproduces every station and turns unexplained ridership into reach: Kranji's mean catchment triples. The matrix form was checked against `MCI::huff.shares()`, differing by at most `r formatC(RP$mci_check$max_abs_gap, format = "e", digits = 0)` tap-ins. Value-added: an **outside option** and an **MCI on OD shares** (slide 9).
:::
::: {.zh}
精确校准能复现每个车站，却把未解释的客流变成辐射范围：Kranji 的平均集散范围扩大到三倍。矩阵形式已与 `MCI::huff.shares()` 对照，差距最多 `r formatC(RP$mci_check$max_abs_gap, format = "e", digits = 0)` 次进站。附加价值：**外部选项**与**基于 OD 份额的 MCI**（第 9 页）。
:::
:::

## <span class="en">Calibration: what makes a station attractive</span><span class="zh">校准：什么让车站具有吸引力</span> {#calibration}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">04 · FINDINGS, RQ1</span><span class="zh">04 · 发现，研究问题一</span>
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="54%"}
```{r}
#| label: slide-ladder
#| fig-width: 7.4
#| fig-height: 6.5

keep <- c("M1 ", "M3 ", "M4 ", "M5 ", "M7 ", "M8 ", "DRM")
lb <- c(`M1 ` = "Huff, equal attraction", `M3 ` = "+ mode and interchange", `M4 ` = "+ retail and food",
        `M5 ` = "+ non-residential markets", `M7 ` = "Two ends, rail time, no limit", `M8 ` = "Selected: 5 km choice set",
        DRM = "Direct regression, same variables")
d <- bind_rows(lapply(keep, \(k) lad(k) |> mutate(key = k))) |>
  mutate(lab = factor(lb[key], rev(lb[keep])), sel = key == "M8 ") |>
  pivot_longer(c(insample, lolo_r2)) |>
  mutate(name = recode(name, insample = "In sample", lolo_r2 = "Lines held out"))
ggplot(d, aes(value, lab)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = PAL$grey_l) +
  geom_line(aes(group = lab), colour = PAL$grey_l, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = name, size = sel)) +
  geom_text(data = filter(d, name == "Lines held out"), aes(label = num(value)), nudge_y = .34, size = 4, colour = PAL$ink) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 5, `FALSE` = 3.4), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(`In sample` = "#a8a29e", `Lines held out` = PAL$new)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-.32, .85)) +
  labs(x = "R² of log ridership", y = NULL) +
  theme_slide(15)
```
:::

::: {.column width="46%" .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">What the model says</span><span class="zh">模型说明了什么</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
- An LRT-only station pulls about **`r pct(100 * exp(ch(RP$coef_H, "lrt")), 0)`** of an MRT station in the same surroundings
- Each extra line: **×`r num(exp(ch(RP$coef_H, "ic")), 1)`**
- Doubling retail: **+`r pct(100 * (2^ch(RP$coef_H, "l_ret") - 1), 0)`**
- Doubling rail time to the CBD: **−`r pct(100 * (1 - 2^ch(RP$coef_H, "l_cbd")), 0)`**
- Home access decays at **`r num(ch(RP$coef_H, "lambda"), 1)`**; the activity end is flatter and uncertain
:::
::: {.zh}
- 纯轻轨车站的吸引力约为周边相同的地铁车站的 **`r pct(100 * exp(ch(RP$coef_H, "lrt")), 0)`**
- 每多一条线路：**×`r num(exp(ch(RP$coef_H, "ic")), 1)`**
- 零售加倍：**+`r pct(100 * (2^ch(RP$coef_H, "l_ret") - 1), 0)`**
- 到 CBD 的轨道时间加倍：**−`r pct(100 * (1 - 2^ch(RP$coef_H, "l_cbd")), 0)`**
- 居住端衰减指数为 **`r num(ch(RP$coef_H, "lambda"), 1)`**；活动端更平缓且不确定
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">The best score was the wrong model</span><span class="zh">分数最高的并非正确模型</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
With no distance limit, hold-out reaches `r num(lad("M7")$lolo_r2)`, but a station 10 km from any new line loses 10%. A 5 km choice set gives back a little fit and removes that.
:::
::: {.zh}
不限距离时留出分数达 `r num(lad("M7")$lolo_r2)`，但距新线 10 公里的车站也损失 10%。5 公里选择集牺牲少量拟合，消除了这一点。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">Checks</span><span class="zh">检验</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Permutation p = `r num(RP$perm_p)`. Low-ridership AUC `r num(RP$auc_low)`. Rank correlation `r num(lad("M8 ")$lolo_rho)`.
:::
::: {.zh}
置换检验 p = `r num(RP$perm_p)`。低客流 AUC `r num(RP$auc_low)`。秩相关 `r num(lad("M8 ")$lolo_rho)`。
:::
:::
:::
:::

## <span class="en">Ridership at the new stations</span><span class="zh">新站的客流</span> {#newstations}

<span class="en">05 · FINDINGS, RQ2</span><span class="zh">05 · 发现，研究问题二</span>
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="63%"}
```{r}
#| label: slide-new
#| fig-width: 8.7

nt <- NT |> mutate(station_name = fct_reorder(station_name, E_closed))
ggplot(nt, aes(y = station_name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = SC$HUME, linetype = 3, colour = PAL$grey) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = SC$LOW20, linetype = 2, colour = "#a8a29e") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_closed, xend = hi_closed, yend = station_name), colour = PAL$new_l, linewidth = 1.8) +
  annotate("text", x = SC$HUME, y = levels(nt$station_name)[29], label = "Hume", size = 3.6, colour = PAL$grey, vjust = -1.5) +
  annotate("text", x = SC$LOW20, y = levels(nt$station_name)[29], label = "Lowest fifth of MRT", size = 3.6, colour = PAL$grey, vjust = -1.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = E_closed, colour = project), size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(JRL = PAL$new, `CRL Phase 1` = "#7c2d12")) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma, breaks = c(1000, 3000, 10000, 30000)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Daily tap-ins with 90% range (log scale)", y = NULL) +

  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(18, 8, 4, 2), legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(.88, .1))
```
:::

::: {.column width="37%" .t-xs}
::: {.kpi-row}
::: {.kpi .kpi-water}
[`r rnd(TT$new_stations[1], 1000)`]{.kpi-val}
[<span class="en">A day in all; simulated `r rnd(SC$totals_ci$closed$new[1], 1000)` to `r rnd(SC$totals_ci$closed$new[2], 1000)`</span><span class="zh">每日合计；模拟范围 `r rnd(SC$totals_ci$closed$new[1], 1000)` 至 `r rnd(SC$totals_ci$closed$new[2], 1000)`</span>]{.kpi-lab}
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">Reading it</span><span class="zh">如何解读</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
- **Heartland infill leads**, west industrial and airport stations trail
- A station's range is about **fivefold**, so **order** is firmer than level
- **JRL `r rnd(SC$by_project$closed[SC$by_project$project == "JRL"], 1000)`**, **CRL `r rnd(SC$by_project$closed[SC$by_project$project != "JRL"], 1000)`**; the median station is alike on both
- Median new station `r rnd(median(NT$E_closed), 100)`, a little over half the MRT median
:::
::: {.zh}
- **组屋区填补型车站居前**，西部工业区与机场车站居后
- 单站范围约为**五倍**，所以**排序**比水平更可靠
- **裕廊区域线 `r rnd(SC$by_project$closed[SC$by_project$project == "JRL"], 1000)`**，**跨岛线 `r rnd(SC$by_project$closed[SC$by_project$project != "JRL"], 1000)`**；两线中位车站相近
- 新站中位数 `r rnd(median(NT$E_closed), 100)`，略高于地铁中位数的一半
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-quiet}
[<span class="en">Why the range sits high</span><span class="zh">范围为何偏高</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
Errors with a long upper tail sum upward, so the simulated total lies mostly above the central estimate.
:::
::: {.zh}
长上尾的误差相加后偏高，所以模拟总量大多高于中心估计。
:::
:::
:::
:::

Adding `r n_fmt(SC$tengah$residents_added)` residents lifts Tengah Plantation from `r rnd(stn("Tengah Plantation", "E_closed", NT))` to `r rnd(stn("Tengah Plantation", "E_2030", NT))` and Tengah from `r rnd(stn("Tengah", "E_closed", NT))` to `r rnd(stn("Tengah", "E_2030", NT))`. Shops and buses would add more.

增加 `r n_fmt(SC$tengah$residents_added)` 名居民后，Tengah Plantation 从 `r rnd(stn("Tengah Plantation", "E_closed", NT))` 升至 `r rnd(stn("Tengah Plantation", "E_2030", NT))`，Tengah 从 `r rnd(stn("Tengah", "E_closed", NT))` 升至 `r rnd(stn("Tengah", "E_2030", NT))`。商店与公交还会带来更多。

```{r}

NT |>
  arrange(desc(p_below_hume)) |>
  head(6) |>
  transmute(Station = station_name, `Tap-ins` = E_closed, `P(< Hume)` = p_below_hume, `P(lowest fifth)` = p_below_low20) |>
  gt() |>

```

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">The yardsticks</span><span class="zh">标尺</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
**Hume today: `r n_fmt(SC$HUME)`** a day, the last station held back for lack of demand. **Lowest fifth of MRT: `r n_fmt(SC$LOW20)`**. No station is more likely than not to fall below Hume, but **`r sum(NT$p_below_low20 > .5)` of `r nrow(NT)`** probably land in the lowest fifth.
:::
::: {.zh}
**Hume 目前每日 `r n_fmt(SC$HUME)` 次**，它是最近一个因需求不足而推迟的车站。**地铁最低五分之一界线 `r n_fmt(SC$LOW20)` 次**。没有车站低于 Hume 的概率过半，但 **`r nrow(NT)` 个中有 `r sum(NT$p_below_low20 > .5)` 个**很可能落入最低五分之一。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Risk is more likely understated</span><span class="zh">风险更可能被低估</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
The model gives Hume `r rnd(RP$residuals_tbl$E[RP$residuals_tbl$station_name == "Hume"])`, not `r n_fmt(SC$HUME)`. It overpredicts at the very bottom.
:::
::: {.zh}
模型给 Hume 的估计是 `r rnd(RP$residuals_tbl$E[RP$residuals_tbl$station_name == "Hume"])`，而不是 `r n_fmt(SC$HUME)`。它在最底部倾向于高估。
:::
:::
:::
:::

west <- c(8500, 24000, 30500, 44000)
dom_map <- function(col, title, show_new) {
  d <- hi |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |> group_by(st = .data[[col]]) |> summarise(.groups = "drop")
  d$k <- factor(((seq_len(nrow(d)) * 7) %% 11) + 1)

::: {.en}
**`r pct(100 * MC$line_summary$beyond_line[MC$line_summary$project == "JRL"], 0)`** of JRL and **`r pct(100 * MC$line_summary$beyond_line[MC$line_summary$project != "JRL"], 0)`** of CRL boardings leave the new line. Stations losing tap-ins become the **interchanges** that carry them on.
:::
::: {.zh}
裕廊区域线 **`r pct(100 * MC$line_summary$beyond_line[MC$line_summary$project == "JRL"], 0)`**、跨岛线 **`r pct(100 * MC$line_summary$beyond_line[MC$line_summary$project != "JRL"], 0)`** 的上车乘客会离开新线。损失进站量的车站成为继续运送他们的**换乘站**。
:::
:::

::: {.card}
[<span class="en">Relief stops at Jurong East</span><span class="zh">缓解止于 Jurong East</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}

:::
::: {.zh}
Jurong East 至 Chinese Garden `r chg(lnk("Jurong East", "Chinese Garden"))`，而 Clementi 至 Jurong East 只有 `r chg(lnk("Clementi", "Jurong East"))`。Serangoon 至 Lorong Chuan `r chg(lnk("Serangoon", "Lorong Chuan"))`。
:::
:::

::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Outside option: not identified</span><span class="zh">外部选项：无法识别</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
The share of home-end riders new to rail can run from `r pct(100 * RP$prof_a0$share_induced[1], 0)` to `r pct(100 * RP$prof_a0$share_induced[RP$prof_a0$lA0 == 2], 0)` with in-sample fit unchanged. `r pct(100 * sum(AF$res_by_nearest[1:4]), 0)` of residents already live within 2 km of a station.
:::
::: {.zh}
居住端乘客中轨道新用户的比例可在 `r pct(100 * RP$prof_a0$share_induced[1], 0)` 到 `r pct(100 * RP$prof_a0$share_induced[RP$prof_a0$lA0 == 2], 0)` 之间变化，而样本内拟合不变。`r pct(100 * sum(AF$res_by_nearest[1:4]), 0)` 的居民已住在车站 2 公里内。
:::

## <span class="en">Limitations and implications</span><span class="zh">局限与启示</span> {#implications}

::: {.eyebrow}
<span class="en">10 · FOR TRANSPORT PLANNING</span><span class="zh">10 · 对交通规划的意义</span>
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="46%" .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-fire}
[<span class="en">Limitations</span><span class="zh">局限</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
- **One cross-section.** Competition today stands in for what a new line does
- **Today's land use.** Buangkok was shut once too; shops and buses follow homes
- **Tap-ins, not line ridership.** Not comparable with LTA's whole-line figures
- **Straight-line access.** No walking network or feeder bus routes
- **Assumption-heavy total.** `r rnd(min(SN$new_total), 1000)` to `r rnd(max(SN$new_total), 1000)` across cases, though the ranking holds (ρ ≈ 0.88 or better in all but one)
:::
::: {.zh}
- **只有一个截面。** 用今天的竞争代替新线的实际效果
- **当前土地利用。** Buangkok 也曾关闭；商店与公交随住宅而来
- **进站量不是线路客流。** 不能与 LTA 的全线数字比较
- **直线到达距离。** 没有步行网络与接驳公交线路
- **总量依赖假设。** 各情形从 `r rnd(min(SN$new_total), 1000)` 到 `r rnd(max(SN$new_total), 1000)`，但排序稳健（除一种情形外 ρ 约为 0.88 或以上）
:::
:::
:::

::: {.column width="54%" .t-xs}
::: {.card .card-water}
[<span class="en">Implications</span><span class="zh">启示</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
- **Stage shell stations by land use.** Aviation Park, Jurong Pier, Tengah and Jurong Hill are identifiable now; tie fit-out and opening to a measurable local threshold
- **Plan interchanges for transfers.** Falling tap-ins at Boon Lay could read as reassurance; its platforms say otherwise
- **Expect the western East-West Line to change.** Feeder buses are the natural counterpart, and shorter access is a gain even as tap-ins fall
- **Measure the openings.** Staged openings from 2028 are a natural experiment that could settle how much ridership a line creates, if OD data are kept
:::
::: {.zh}
- **按土地利用安排外壳车站。** Aviation Park、Jurong Pier、Tengah 与 Jurong Hill 现在就能识别；把装修与开放同可测的本地阈值挂钩
- **按换乘规划换乘站。** Boon Lay 进站量下降可能令人安心，它的站台却并非如此
- **预期东西线西段发生变化。** 接驳公交是自然的配套；即使进站量下降，到达距离变短也是收益
- **对开通进行测量。** 2028 年起的分阶段开通是天然实验，只要保存 OD 数据，就能回答一条线能创造多少客流
:::
:::
:::
:::

::: {.takeaway}
[<span class="en">The handout's wording</span><span class="zh">手册的措辞</span>]{.lab}

::: {.en}
The handout's "public-safety" and "peace-keeping" implications are read as transport-planning implications, the policy question this exercise poses. These are one student's readings, offered as questions.
:::
::: {.zh}
手册中的“公共安全”与“维和”启示被理解为交通规划启示，也就是本次作业所提的政策问题。这些只是一名学生的解读，是提出的问题。
:::
:::
